finalText:
Migration complete. Every application call site now uses `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already established in `shipmentService.js`/`ticketService.js`.

One file was left untouched on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still calls `db.query`, but its header explicitly says it's a vendored copy that's "replaced wholesale on every upgrade" and local edits are silently lost — so editing it wouldn't stick. Since `db.query` is still defined (just deprecated, not removed) in `lib/db.js`, this doesn't break anything today, but it's worth flagging to whoever owns the vendor upgrade so it gets fixed upstream before `query` is actually dropped.
